Contributing to medfit

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

medfit is the foundation package of the mediationverse: it provides S7 classes, extraction, fitting and bootstrap infrastructure, and leaves effect-size methods to the packages built on it. Read the architecture guide for how the pieces fit together.

Branches

Branch Role
main released code; changed by pull request only
dev integration branch; start work from here
feature/* one change each, opened as a pull request to dev

Use conventional commit messages (feat:, fix:, docs:, test:, chore:). Squash-merge feature pull requests into dev; release pull requests from dev to main use a merge commit.

Check your change locally first

dev is gated locally, because R-CMD-check runs on GitHub only for pull requests and pushes to main.

scripts/check-local.sh            # quick tests, then R CMD check on a built tarball
scripts/check-local.sh --tests-only

In R:

devtools::document()   # after changing roxygen comments
devtools::test()
lintr::lint_package()

Tests that need NOT_CRAN=true (simulation tests) are skipped by check-local.sh; run the suite with NOT_CRAN=true before a pull request that changes numbers. Verify a numeric claim against an independent oracle (lavaan, a hand calculation, a fit without the feature) and plant a defect the test must catch.

What the hosted checks do

Check Runs on Notes
lint pull requests pinned to ubuntu-24.04; timeout 35 minutes (a cold package cache compiles OpenMx from source)
pkgdown pull requests pinned to ubuntu-24.04; articles evaluate their code, so an article that breaks fails here; not run for changes only under planning/, tests/ or .claude/
risk-tier pull requests to dev and main a change to the objective, parameters, constraints, bounds or solver path needs the admission checklist in the pull request body
R-CMD-check, gates, test-coverage pull requests to main and pushes to main only the platform matrix, the simulation gates (gates (rest), gates (reliability)) and hosted coverage are release-time cost

Pinning to ubuntu-24.04 fixed a stall where setup-r hung at apt-get update on a newer image. If a hosted job stalls in its setup step, rerun it once; a second failure is a real problem.

Documentation

Articles in vignettes/articles/ are Quarto files that evaluate their code at site build; chunk options use the hash-pipe form (#| label: my-chunk, lowercase true/false). Every guide-*.qmd must be in the articles index and the Guides menu of _pkgdown.yml; tests/testthat/test-guide-pages.R checks this. Every classed condition the package signals (medfit_error_*, medfit_warning_*) must be named in the docs; tests/testthat/test-condition-docs.R checks this, so add a row to the Troubleshooting guide with a new condition.

Update NEWS.md under the development heading for any user-visible change. Spelling is US English.

Breaking changes

Open an issue with the [BREAKING] prefix, keep a deprecation period of at least two months with lifecycle::deprecate_warn(), and document the migration path. A correctness fix that replaces a wrong result with the right one skips the deprecation period but needs a NEWS behavior-change note.
